title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
A 23-year-old Chinese student is standing trial in Zurich for attempted murder after stabbing three five-year-old boys at an after-school care center in Oerlikon on 1 October 2024. One child had a jugular vein severed and needed emergency surgery, another suffered two chest wounds that damaged his heart and major blood vessels, and the third was injured in the ear and lung. A childcare worker grabbed the attacker’s arms, forcing him to drop the knife and surrender before passersby held him for police.

Prosecutors say he planned the attack for weeks, using ChatGPT to ask about legal consequences of stabbing random victims and choosing children as targets. He bought clothes and kitchen knives, studied anatomy, and purchased raw beef on 30 September to practice stabbing. The prosecution describes the act as exceptionally cold-blooded and motivated by revenge, a need for recognition, and ideological delusion. At Thursday’s hearing, they are seeking a 15-year prison sentence and a 15-year expulsion from Switzerland.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
